title: podcast_scraper
summary: Close Listening's public core: the ingestion pipeline (RSS, transcription, diarization, cleaning, summaries, grounded insights, knowledge graph), the corpus and its migrations, search, the API that serves the corpus and the app state, and the gi-kg-viewer. Private extensions (Common) add stages and commands through the seams.
notes: Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md, linked below section by section; CLAUDE.md adds Claude Code specifics. Docs are an MkDocs site under docs/: ADRs, RFCs and PRDs each have an index (linked under Decisions and specs), guides are listed in full, architecture docs describe the system as built, docs/wip holds plans and the corpus change records.
Every change to what the corpus serves starts with its change record (docs/guides/CORPUS_CHANGE_METHOD.md). Prod and deployment runbooks are operator documentation, not in this repository.
This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and `make llms-txt-check` fails when it is stale or a link does not resolve.
